# `WF2LEA-14` — Carry lesson SCOPE through the /api/lessons write path and honor it on read (MemoryScope.WORKSPACE stops being inert)

## Intent — what this is for

Traced defect, not a task row: the mcp_memory memory_remember scope/workspace pair was advertised, validated and enforced client-side, then dropped by api_lessons_create and absent from both write_lesson layers. Owned here because WF2LEA-3 owns the three /api/lessons consumers and WF2LEA-13 owns how a lesson reaches a prompt.

## Done when

POST /api/lessons {scope:'workspace', workspace:'<absolute cwd>'} persists scope='workspace' + scope_ref=realpath(cwd) on the lesson.* row (handler -> memory_service.write_lesson -> vector_memory.write_lesson) and reads back that way from a fresh store; the lesson is invisible to another working directory and to any reader with no working directory (including build_session_context() with no cwd, the grill-tree recall and the debug preview) while a global lesson still reaches everyone; the endpoint REFUSES rather than downgrades - missing workspace, non-absolute workspace, and unknown-or-unwritable scope (session/agent) each 400 with nothing written; every MemoryScope member is mapped with no default branch; get_lessons stays the full INVENTORY read so list/count/delete still see a workspace lesson while lessons_visible_in/get_lessons_context are fail-closed; dedup is bucket-scoped and a workspace key is lesson.ws.<hash(ref+rule)> so a narrower write can never supersede or re-scope a global lesson; existing all-global lessons render byte-identically (additive, no migration); enum:MemoryScope.WORKSPACE leaves inert-surface-baseline.json (140 -> 139)
